name: Story Engine fonts
_note: P88 GAM-016: the passage prose face, bundled rather than fetched, like the starter project's Inter. It used to be Iowan Old Style, which only Apple machines carry, so a Windows reader got Palatino Linotype or Georgia. Source Serif 4 is SIL Open Font License 1.1; the licence travels beside it. Latin and Latin-extended subsets.
